privacy.reason_for_default_on: per-clip bias scores (the strength sweep) drive the per-recording flip-threshold readout shown in the calibration recordings UI — the feature's whole purpose

description: Per-clip bias-score readings (one entry per clip × scoring-run): the flip threshold (lowest never-standalone penalty strength that decodes to the prompt), the unbiased + flipped decodes, and the model version it ran on. Append-only history keyed by clip file.
